handoff: Tick lines keep their decisions inline and store facts as a $chunked skeleton. Each story (with run hooks as 64-fact $blocks), machine, remote.issues, replay config and each workflow source is a chunk in <day>.chunks.jsonl, written in one fsynced append before the tick line (store tick-trace.ts: appendTick, tickReader/readTickInputs). why and the golden harvest read chunked and full-facts ticks. A missing chunk gives exit 4 trace_corrupt. S2 tests are in store config-trace.test.ts, including a byte-for-byte round-trip of every golden case. S1 tests are in cli chunked-ticks.test.ts. PRD O4/O5/X4 amended. Full suite (1260) and typecheck green. The PR body must name the downgrade as the merge danger (AC13).

notes.text: Spike on a real 515 KB tick from this repo: decisions are 14.7 KB inline (51 units, mostly noops, ~250 B each), and D6/B35 keep them inline. I chunked machine (3.9 KB) as the largest part that can be chunked. A quiet tick is under 5 KB at harness scale (AC1), but about 18 KB on this repo. B13's 5 KB does not hold for repos with dozens of units unless decisions shrink.

bun run golden adds 3 cases (check-run x2, cockpit) for check.running and agent.attended.running. The base adds the very same names, so these are coverage gaps that already existed. I did not commit them; add them in their own change if wanted.
